tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i bzhugs byang dkar chag tshogs gnyis khang bzang bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang la skyabs su nges par song tsam gyis// lam log 'phyan dang 'jigs pa kun las skyob// bde legs 'byung gnas sdom pa kun bskyed pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyis tshe rabs kun tu skyongs// shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i ston mchog gis// ngo mtshar mdzad pa gang du bstan pa der// chos sku'i yon tan mtshon byed mchod pa'i rten// gang dag byung ba kun la phyag bgyi'o// de yi nang gsel 'phags yul rdo rje'i gdan// bdud las rgyal ba mngon par sangs rgyas tshe// dad ldan gyis brtsigs dper byas byang chub che'i// mchod rten phyag 'os bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar gleng*// de yang dkon mchog skyabs song dge ba'i bshes// sangs rgyas seng ge zhes bya'i dal 'byor rten// sgyu ma'i skyes chen rnga lam bteg pa na// dge tshogs bsgrub las gzhan pa'i phan byed ci// khyad par ngan 'gro'i skye sgo 'gegs pa dang*// mtho ris thar pa'i phyogs rab snang byed kyi// rin chen sgron me lta bu mchod rten te// cha brgyad nang gsel byang chub mchod rten ni// dam chos pad dkar gsal rgyal zhus pa sogs// bka' lung tshad mas bde gshegs mchod pa'i rten// bzhengs pa'i phan yon bsam brjod yul 'das dang*// phyag mchod bgyis pa'i bsod nams phung po'i tshad// chu gter che dang dbyar skyes rkang thung tshal// ji snyed khams dang 'dri byed smyig gu'i rgyur// song ba snyan dngags lam du 'dren pa la// rig byed 'byin po'i blo yang lan brgyar ngal// de yang bzo legs mtshan nyid tshang ba la// chos gzugs sku yi ring bsrel snying po can// rab tu gnas pa'i byin rlabs ldan pa las// nges par gsungs kyi gyi na'i bems por min// de slad rten mchog 'di yi bzhugs tshul gyi// gleng ba mi 'gyur phreng du bstar ba yi// ngo mtshar brjod pas tshogs bsags phyag mchod sogs// gang dag byed la yid ches bskyed 'di ko

/de yang thog mar bzo dbyibs tshad las drangs// bar du chos gzugs sku yi ring bsrel gtams// tha mar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga yis// byin rlabs phyag mchod yul du bskrun tshul lo// dang por chos sku'i rang bzhin mchod rten chad// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs bka' don dag /'grel byed mkhas pa'i lugs srol mang mchis mod// deng 'dir brang ti mkhas pa'i legs bshad nyid// gtsor bzung chu zheng gab pa'i cha yi tshad// gzhan dring mi 'jog legs sbyangs bzo bo yis// dbyar skyes spong shing bzang po'i rgyur bskrun par// rtsi tshon rin chen gser gyi rgyan phreng gis// mdzes sdug mig gi bdud rtsi'i rnam par bskrun// gnyis par 'jig rten khams na ren thang tshad// stong gsum yangs par rin chen phung po yis// phyur bur gtams pas cha shas 'tshob min pa// bde gshegs 'od srungs chen po'i ring bsrel dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nyid// rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs pa 'grel pa'i phyir// mi srid tshul bzung dad sgrol sa skya pa// brtse chen snying po'i bla gos snam sbyar dang*// paṇa chen bsod nams rtse mo'i bsnyel 'bol dum// rdo rje 'chang chen kun dga' bzang po dang*// shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas sa skya pa// sngags 'chang kun bkras kun dga' bsod rin dang*// mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bsod nams bzang po byams pa ngur 'chang zol// mkhan chen grub dbang bkra shis lhun grub pa// thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub zhabs// gong sa chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug sogs// mkhas dang grub pa'i sar gnas rnam mang gi /sku la bgos pa'i na bza' byin rlabs can// spur ras tshal bu 'khrul med gang dag dang*// bka' drin mnyam med mkhan chen chos kyi rje// dpal ldan chos skyong grags pa'i sku bal dang*// na bza' spur ras sku mtshal yid ches dang*// dpal ldan sa skya e waṃ chos ldan du// gang dag bzhugs pa'i 'phags bod yul byon gyi// rgyal ba rgyal sras tshogs kyi ring bsrel gzugs// gcig tu bsdus pa rten 'dam dpe zlar bral// dkar chag logs su gsal bar gang bzhugs dang*// sde dge sa skyong bla dpon rim byon gyi// thugs dam rten du bcangs pa'i rten 'dam las// bskrun pa'i bla ma yi dam chos srung dang*// nor lha bcas pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can// de nyid grangs

25 ldan dag dang sa skya pa'i// rje btsun mchog gis rdo rje gzhon nu yi// dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dus kyi rdul tshon dang*// paṇa chen ga ya dha ra nas brtsams te// rje btsun mchog gyur gang dag byon rnams kyis// tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i rgyun ldan sa skya pa'i// dam tshig rdzas mchog ril bu brgya do dang*// sil ma kha shas e waṃ chos ldan pa'i// gdan rabs rim par byon pas bsgrubs pa yi// khyad par can gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig rdzas// gtso phal bsdams pa'i grangs ni stong phrag lhag /bstan srung dbang po gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon sku brnyan khyad 'phags bcas// byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba de dag dang*// mchod rten dbus kyi srog shing ngos bzhi la// 'dri bar 'os pa'i sa bon gzungs sngags dang*// rtse mjug mchod rten rgya gram mtshan pa btsugs// chos sku'i ring bsrel zhes bya gzungs sngags rigs// byin rlabs can du bzhed de de yang ni// lhun grub steng gi chos grwa 'di nyid du// par du 'khod pa dkar chag zur gsal bzhin// zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor rim brgyud kyi// mtshan gyi phreng ba nas brtsam kye rdo rje'i// bka' babs bzhi dang bdag med lha mo dang*// gur dang kha sbyor dus 'khor bde ba'i mchog /lo nag dril gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*// phur pa gsang 'dus 'jigs byed sbyong dkyil dang*// a ra pa tsa na dang tshe dpag med// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho so thar sdom pa'i rgyud// gur zhal mgon dkar dam can beg tse dang*// phyag na rdo rje rnam sras zhi drag gi /bka' srol brgyud pa'i rin chen mtshan phreng rnams// yongs su rdzogs pa tshar lnga chos 'khor gyi// rtse nas bre mgul yan chad khyab par bzhugs// rnal 'byor bla med dges pa rdo rje yi// rtsa bshad rgyud gsum gyis bstan lha yi sngags// dus 'khor phur pa 'khor lo bde mchog skor// gshin rje'i gshed skor rnam snang sgyu drwa sogs// bla med rgyud kyi nges bstan lha sngags dang*// las sngags ji snyed gsungs pa'i sngags phreng rnams// mchod rten bre nas bum stod yan chad bzhugs// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi// rgyud sde'i nges bstan rdor dbyings kun rig sogs// lhag pa'i lha yi gsang sngags skor mang yod// spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon par byang chub sogs// rigs gsum rgyud kyis bstan pa'i gsang ba'i sngags// bya ba'i rgyud la don yod zhags pa sogs// bya ba spyi dang so so'i rgyud de yis// dngos bstan sngags dang bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan// brgya rtsa brgyad sogs mtshan gzungs mdo gzungs 'ga'// rgyud sde 'og mar grags pa'i gzungs sngags rnams// bang rim bzhi pa yan chad khyab par bzhugs// gong 'og rgyud sde'i gzungs sngags yongs rdzogs ni// tshar grangs bco lnga re dang gzungs sde lngar// zhi drag gtsug tor rnam rgyal dri med dang*// gsang ba ring bsrel byang chub rgyan 'bum dang*// rten 'brel snying po snga ma'i grangs mnyam dang*// chos srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon gyis mtshon bstan srung ni// drag rtsal che dgu kun dang nor gyi lha// rnam mang thos sogs gnod sbyin nor bdag sogs// dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga'i gzungs sngags dang*// phun sum tshogs 'dzin khyim bdag dpal sbas la// stsal bas nyer mtshon dkon mchog rnam gsum gyi// bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa mang po dang*// pha rol phyin drug smon lam bsngo ba'i rigs// bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam bcas pa ste// pad gdan seng khrir bzhugs bya'i gzungs sde rnams// tshar grangs nyer gcig bar bzhugs de dag kyang*// gos dar ser po'i na bza' dri bzang bcas// rgya bod mkhas pa kun gyi bzhed srol dang*// rjes mthun gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo ni// tshul bzhin bsgrubs dang glo bur rab gnas can// kho nas bzhugs pa'i gnod sbyin bang mdzod du// gser dngul ja dar 'bru sna shing thog rigs// rin chen phye ma rgya bod gnas chen sa// sna tshogs dar gos ras mo nor gter gyi// bum pa tshad ldan bsgrubs pa dang bcas pa// rten mchog 'di nang bzhugs pa'i nang rten rnams// rags rim yi ge'i lam nas gleng ba'o// gsum par rten bzhengs bya ba mthar phyin nas// lhar bcas skye dgu'i mchod sdong chen po ru// rab gnas cho gas mnga' gsol bgyi slad du// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sogs// bzang drug 'dzom pa'i cho ga rnam dag gis// rten mchog 'di yi rdul phran go rer yang*// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs// gang phyir bsod nams tshogs la mngon dga' ba'i// dad pa'i snying nor ldan pa gang dag gis// phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar dang*// rgyal ba'i zhing khams til gyi gong bu ltas// mngon par gtams pa'i mchod yul shes nas ni// bkur sti ri mor bgyis gang de yi rgyud// bsod nams dpag yas thob pa rgyal ba'i gsung*// mdo sngags tshad mas bstan la yid ches byos// bla med skyabs kyi dam pa sangs rgyas kyi// rten gsum 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser nas brtsams// rdo shing 'jim pa'i rgyu las gang byed pa// thams cad bla med byang chub 'thob 'gyur gsungs// gcig tu bsod nams brgya pa'i dge mtshan can// rgyal ba'i sku dngos mchod yul thob pa dang*// de nyid mya ngan las 'das gzugs brnyan la// mchod pas mdun bdar bsod nams mnyam par bshad// gang phyir zhe na sangs rgyas rang snang du// 'pho 'gyur bral yang gdul bya gzhan snang ngor// 'das bzhugs 'byon dang mchog dman bar ma'i gzugs// sprul pa'i 'gro don rgyun chad med phyir ro// 'dir 'bad legs byas 'dzam bu'i snye ma bzang*// 'khor 'das bsod nams rgya mtshor ro gcig 'dres// byang chen spyod pa'i mdog bzang mngon gyur nas// 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs pa'i nor bur gyur// so thar byang sems sngags sdom yan lag bcas// dngos brgyud legs 'doms mkhan po bla ma dang*// rdo rje'i slob dpon gyur pa thams cad kyi// zab yangs thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs rdzogs shog

/dal 'byor bskyed drin che ba'i pha ma dang*// sangs rgyas seng ges nyer mtshon sems can rnams// byang chub bar gyi skye bar dal 'byor gyi// mi lus dge chos spyod ldan skye bar shog /rten des skyabs su dkon mchog gsum gzung zhing*// de yi bslab bya gzhan don byang chub mchog /smon dang 'jug pa'i spyod pa zab rgya che// slob pa'i snying stobs nam yang dri med shog /tshul 'dir rgyu sbyor mthun rkyen 'brel thogs rnams// tshul khrims la gnas thos bsam bsgom par brtson// rab 'byams rgyal ba rgyal ba'i rten gsum bcas// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin chen spro bar shog /zla bas sprul pa'i bi shwa na ra'i bu// mi sbyin skyes las byung ba'i dag byed bzhin// dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes bslus pa'i gtam// srid la min pas smras don 'grub gyur cig /ces byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i bzhugs byang dkar chag tshogs gnyis khang bzang bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas tshigs su bcad pa'i lam nas mdor bsdus te gleng ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ //bskal pa bzang po'i legs bris dga' tshal du// yid srubs thub mchog sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan stong*// rnam par bzhad las thub dbang pad+ma dkar// lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan zas gtsang sras// gang gi zhal lung chu gter chen po las// 'gyod tshang thar mdo bde ldan mgon po'i mdo// zung gi dag byed rlabs phreng su zhig gis// 'dri klog dad pa'i snyim pas btung tsam gyis// tshe rabs lu gu rgyud bsags sdig pa'i dri// skad cig gcig sbyangs sems rgyud zhing sa ru// dge ba'i sa bon stobs su rdzogs pa'i rtser// tshogs gnyis snye ma g.yur du zar nges pa// gang 'di chos ldan sa 'dzin tshe ring skyabs// rigs sras rin chen chos 'phel zung dag gis// rin chen bum pa brgya skyes zhun ma yis// 'dri bar byed pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar te bzhengs// tshul 'dir 'bad dang sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs// gang dag bsags pa gyi na'i phyir min par// gzhan don bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur// 'khor gsum dmigs pa'i dug bral klong du bsngo// phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing na dus gsum du// gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen// sras dang slob mar bcas pa ji snyed dag

/deng 'dir smon lam 'grub pa'i bden dpang spyon// kun mkhyen gsung rab 'dri klog bgyis pa yis// nyer mtshon sgo gsum dge ba gang bsags pa// ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdams pa 'dis// chu klung bye ba rgya mtshor 'jug rjes snyegs// sbyin bdag tsheṃ rabs riṃng mor bsags pa'i sdig /skyabaṃs gsum spyan sngar mthol bshags byang gyur nas// riṃn cheṃn choṃs mchog thos bsam bsgom pa'i blo// bla med byang chub phyogs su 'phelaṃ gyur cig /skye ba 'di nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen// mngon du bgyis pa de srid skye nas skyer// mi khom brgyad las ring 'das dal 'byor lus// sdig spong dge bcu sgrub la spro bar shog /mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su nges bzung bslab byar bcas dgu la// gzhar yang bag med spyod dbang ma btang bar// 'tsho ba'i srog ltar gces par bsrung nus shog /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i gzhung*// rtse gcig sgom pa'i yul la thos bsam dang*// sbyangs stobs dman pa min pas lung rtogs kyi// yon tan mi zad gter dbang 'byor bar shog /'gro la snying brtse byang chub sems ldan pas// pha rol phyin pa drug dang bsdu dngos bzhis// bskal par bsgrub bya'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs// dpag yas chu gter chen po'i mthar son shog /zab dang rgya che'i las bzang byed po yis// ring nas mngon par bskrun pa'i dge mtshan dang*// dpe byad bzang po'i kho lag rab rdzogs gang*// mthong don che ba rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /gang de'i gsang gsum bkod pa dpag yas kyis// mtha' yas gdul bya'i blor 'tsham zab rgya che'i// dam chos bdud rtsi'i gsos kyis thar pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog 'tshor byed par shog /slar yang srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar// lhun grub yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// ji bzhin rgyun mi chad pa'i mdzad pa yis// 'gro khams drug gi don chen 'byung bar shog

/gnas skabs bde rgyu sgrub la bsngo ba'i rten// bde ba'i dpal phrog bro rigs gdon bgegs kyi// nye zho'i mi mthun rgud pa'i mun pa dag /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs 'od brgya pas// reg pa'i mod la rab zhi bde dga'i dpal// ci dgar rtsen pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /ces pa ye na'i dpon tshe ring skyabs yab sras nas/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo dang 'od dpag med pa'i mdo gnyis/ rin chen gser sbyangs khams las grub pa'i yi ger bzhengs pa'i dge tshogs byang chub tu smin pa'i bsngo byang smon lam rnam grol 'jug pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos la dad ldan sbyin pa'i bdag po de nyid nas bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas rab byung me zla'i thams cad 'dul gyi bgrang gzhi shar bar/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi grags pa'i mu khyud phyogs su nyung bsdus su 'phral la bris pa ka l+yā ṇa war+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal snga nas/ sgom chen 'dra zhig nges 'byung skyes pa'i tshigs bcad thor bu zhig gzigs pa mdzad pa po'ang ma nges shing tshig 'di dag bzang dman ci 'dra zhes rtse mtshar du bstan rgyu gnang byung ba na 'di ltar snang ste/ chos thog mar 'tshol ba'i dka' lugs la// de dben par nyams su ma blangs na// pha bla ma rnams kyis thugs khrel zhing*// rang 'gyod pa drag pos 'chi bar snang*// dkyil 1 'khor chen po'i dbang bskur nas// dam tshig sdom pa mi bsrung bar// rim gnyis bsgom zer rmi lam bzhin// rgyal 2 sras sdom pa mi bsgrub par// gsang sngags bsgom pa 'chal ba'i lugs// so 3 sor thar pa'i ming med par// lam mchog mthar phyin 'dod pa ni// ri bo mi mthong rdul mthong bzhin// rang 4 gis ngan 'gro mi khegs pa'i// gzhan bder 'dod pa ya re mtshar// snyigs

5 ma'i dus 'dir bsod nams shes rab chung*// dam chos mod po shes pa'i skal ba med// yi ge drug la mdo rgyud ma lus tshang*// rang gzhan bde ba'i lam la ci nas chug /kha ba can gyi lha mchog spyan ras gzigs// khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'grub par gsungs// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal cher ltos la// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i thabs la 'dod// yi ge drug pa lan gcig thos pa yang*// ma lus sdig pa byang par gsungs pas na// rang gzhan sdig pa'i phung po sbyang ba'i phyir// rab tu go cha khyod kyis gyon// bshad 6 sgrub rnal ma nyams len mi gda'// yi ge drug 'di rang gtso bo gda'// dmyal 7 ba la kha bshad mi brin bsam pa bzang ba brin// dmyal 8 ba mkhas pa mi brin dad pa che ba drin// zhes bris snang ngo*// de dag la bzang dman dpyad pa'i lan rnams rim par 'dri ba ni/ dang po'i lan ni/ dbang thob dam tshig bsrung dgos mod// dam tshig ltung ba byung ba 'ga'// rim gnyis bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro dang*// dngos gzhi'i sor chud 'gyur ba'i tshul// ma shes skyon gyis snying phugs 'tshang*// rim gnyis bsgom pa rmi lam bzhin// zhes pa rmi lam sgyu ma ltar// ma yin khyod kyi rim gnyis de// rtag brtan ther zug khas 'ches pas// khyod sku da ltar 'khor ba'i gnas// gang du rtag bzhugs smra dgos 'gyur// gnyis pa'i lan/ 'o na rgyal sras sdom ldan gyis// sngags kyi dbang bskur ma thob kyang*// gsang sngags bsgom rung khyod smra'am// 'dod na khyod kyang 'chal ba'am// yang na mi shes shes mdog gi /stong zog 'ja' tshon lugs srol zung*// gsum pa'i lan/ so thar sdom pa'i 'bras bu ni// mngon mtho mtho ris rgyur gsungs mod// lam mchog mthar phyin thams cad mkhyen// thob 'dod khyod kyi dbu thog tu// ri bo ltung yang rdul mthong bzhin// bzhi pa'i lan/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas// gzhan phan 'dod la mthu med kyang*// de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya// zhes gsungs pa'ang dran pa mdzod/

lnga pa'i lan/ gal te snyigs dus yin na yang*// dam chos shes skal med don ci// bsod nams bsags dang shes rab bskyed// mi dgos par yang tshogs gnyis mthar// phyin gnas thob 'dod khyod kyi lugs// yig drug dang ni spyan ras gzigs// bzang rab sus kyang shes mod kyi// dbang thob sdom ldan ma yin pas// gsang sngags rgyal po yig drug de// skal ba med pas bzlas gyur na// gsang sngags 'chal bar ma gyur tam// drug pa'i lan/ bshad sgrub rnal ma med gyur na// yig drug kyang ni bshad sgrub la// ma ltos rang rdol byung bas kyang*// sangs rgyas 'grub na ngo mtshar che// bdun pa'i lan/ sdig spong dge sgrub kha bshad rnams// gzhan gyis blang dor shes phyir yin// dmyal ba'i tshong 'dus brin phyir min// bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems// bskyed pa bla med byang chub kyi// spyod mtsho 'gengs pa'i phyir yin mod// dmyal bar 'gro ba'i lam brgyags min// dmyal bar bsam pa bzang brin ces// sdug bsngal myong dgos las de ci// rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhas byas rnams// thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob rgyu las// dmyal ba'i bun skyed mthong bas min// brgyad pa'i lan/ mchog la dad gsum bskyed pa yang*// yon tan rang rgyud bskyed phyir las// dmyal bar 'gro 'dod dad pa min// de phyir sgom chen khyod kyis kyang*// lung rigs thos pa med pa'i gtam// 'di ltas rang gi nang khrol rnams// phyi rol 'don pa ma mdzad cig /ces 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen pa zhes bya bas smras pa rtse 'jo'i tshul du bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
